question: Can bounded nonconservative cycle-topology inference from causal transition observations improve unfamiliar-state intervention prediction and cold retention beyond equally informed fully fitted conventional and exact graph-Bayesian controls?
hypothesis: A point-estimate sparse directed-cycle flow model can identify previously unknown action-conditioned causal topology and carry that knowledge across unobserved action/state pairs. The equal-information exact graph-Bayesian model is the primary comparator and may dominate; that is a valid negative.

inputs.name: synthetic six-node source-free directed-cycle generator protocol
inputs.source: the UTF-8 exact DATA_SPEC string in this preregistration and experiment.py; no original-world or user-data first use

frozen_design.worlds: 10 primary seeds x INVERSE/SAME/INDEPENDENT = 30 independent worlds; 6 observable state labels, separate random hidden 6-cycles; action 0 follows successor; action 1 follows inverse/same/independent successor; true edge probability .90, each alternative .02; labels randomly permuted per world, no hidden cycle/regime disclosed to learners
frozen_design.split: For each world: 2 train transitions per state under action 0 and 2 under action 1 only for states 0,2,4 (18 training; 6 unseen action1 rows). Held 64 independent next-state outcomes for each of 6 states x 2 actions =768 held events/world. Training and held RNG streams SHA-256-keyed separately. 540 train and 23,040 held events total.
frozen_design.ordering: Fit action0 witnesses first, inspect fixed action0 prediction vector, then fit action1 witnesses and evaluate after JSON cold restore; no held labels during fitting.
frozen_design.data_budget: 18 source observations per world per arm; no extra actions/data for any arm
frozen_design.compute_budget: stdlib CPU only; one primary pass; max 30 worlds x 768 held events x all arms; no search or tune on primary outcomes; record per-arm wall and CPU timing, Python/platform, whole-process including graph enumeration, log memory/capacity
frozen_design.capacity: 6 states; all algorithms see same visible (state,action,next_state); candidate single MAP hidden directed Hamiltonian cycle per action and MAP regime; exact Bayes enumerates all 120 directed Hamiltonian 6-cycles, marginalizes inverse/same/independent under equal scenario priors; conventional baseline fully fitted six-way Dirichlet(1) per state/action; no access to scenario labels.
frozen_design.evaluator: full six-class multiclass Brier averaged over 768 held outcomes/world; unfamiliar action1 rows (1,3,5) separately; regime accuracy on INVERSE/INDEPENDENT and false action-effect under SAME; prediction deterioration for familiar action0 before/after action1; byte-identical serialized cold restore; measured whole-process training+prediction cost

controls: equal-source fully fitted row-conditional Dirichlet(1) Markov transition model
fully informed exact graph Bayesian model with identical six-cycle structural family and equal INVERSE/SAME/INDEPENDENT model priors; integrated posterior marginal, no true regime labels
action-blind fitted six-class Dirichlet(1) row transition ablation
negative action-effect NULL control: SAME regime, true action0=action1
new 6-state labels, independent 6-cycle transfer: INDEPENDENT scenario
metrics: familiar action0 Brier before/after learning action1
all-in wall/CPU seconds plus fit/predict time under same host

classification_rules.supported: Candidate must beat the lowest (best) aggregate held multiclass Brier among fully fitted row-Markov and exact Bayes by at least 0.01, OR achieve >=2.0x measured whole-process CPU improvement versus exact Bayes with candidate aggregate Brier <= Bayes+0.005; ALSO SAME false action-difference alarms must be 0/10, INVERSE correctly recovered >=7/10, action0 retention Brier deterioration <=0.01, and all cold restore identities pass. Independent source-owner first use and full native acceptance separately required.
classification_rules.mixed: Candidate improves >=0.01 over unstructured fitted row-Markov on unseen-action1 rows but misses superiority/efficiency or negatives; exploratory source-free only.
classification_rules.negative: All properly executed source-free results not meeting supported/mixed, including exact Bayesian dominance or negative-control failure.
classification_rules.invalid: Unpinned or changed generator, nonidentical inputs, hidden topology/regime leakage, incorrect fully fitted Bayesian comparator, any post-primary tuning, missing test provenance, or mismatch between local executed and repository-frozen source identities. Infrastructure failures separate from science.

preregistration_note: Commit prereg before experimental code and any primary outcomes; commit/read back exact executable before primary scoring; distinct smoke seed only for engineering validation. No new PR; append independent evidence to existing draft PR #1346.
